```yaml
name: Assign milestone to PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened]

jobs:
  assign-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Assign milestone
        run: |
          if [[ $GITHUB_ACTOR == "dependabot[bot]" || $GITHUB_ACTOR == "BornToBeRoot" ]]; then
            gh pr edit --add-milestone next-release ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          fi
```

```yaml
name: Assign labels to PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened]

jobs:
  assign-labels:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Assign labels
        run: |
          if [[ $GITHUB_ACTOR == "dependabot[bot]" || $GITHUB_ACTOR == "transifex-integration[bot]" || $GITHUB_ACTOR == "imgbot[bot]" ]]; then
            gh pr edit --add-label ':heavy_check_mark: dependencies' ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          fi
```
